svg.title: Ticker high-level design
svg.desc: Browsers reach an nginx edge, which serves the React UI and proxies /api to Go API copies. The API and a Go worker use PostgreSQL; the API uses Redis for rate limits and signup codes and Resend for email. A Vercel setup uses Neon and Upstash instead.
svg.text: one network · only the edge port is published
Lock order: event → overdue holds → seats
Expires overdue holds, one per transaction
Row locks decide who gets a seat
API: the same Go code, /api/* rewrites to it
No worker here. A reserve or a seat change first
releases overdue holds on the seats it touches.
Same code, same locks, same database rules.
